WITH product_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS INTEGER)) as total_units
  FROM Order_Items
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY product_id
),
grand_total_calc AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_units) as grand_total FROM product_totals
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.product_id,
    pt.total_units,
    CAST(pt.total_units AS DECIMAL) / gtc.grand_total as share
  FROM product_totals pt
  CROSS JOIN grand_total_calc gtc
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM product_shares
),
above_average_products AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.total_units,
    ps.share,
    asc.avg_share
  FROM product_shares ps
  CROSS JOIN average_share_calc asc
  WHERE ps.share > asc.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(total_units) as combined_units,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess
FROM above_average_products

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity values that are NULL are skipped entirely (not treated as 0); only order items with non-null product_quantity contribute to unit counts
Only products that appear in Order_Items (have at least one order item) are considered when calculating average share
